name: Scorch Release: Majestic Violent Murdering Hellfire Destroyer

sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Wind Release, Fire Release, Clash

system.description:
You conjure an innumerable number of globes of superheated flame, fusing them, to create a single massive sphere of super-heated flame.

Make a ranged ninjutsu attack against a target you can see within range, dealing 8d12 Fire damage on a hit.

Regardless if you hit or miss, all other creatures within 20 feet of the original target must make a Constitution saving throw taking 4d12 Fire damage and gaining 2 ranks of Immolation on a failed save.

Creatures who’s hit points are reduced to 0 as a result of this jutsu are turned to dust and leave behind only a shadow of their physique stained in ash on the ground or wall.

Scorch. By spending 8 Scorch Charges, you can select up to 3 willing creatures within 30 feet of you, to share with you their chakra. These creatures select one jutsu they know of B-Rank or lower that makes an attack as part of casting. They spend their reaction to cast their chosen jutsu, infusing its effects into this jutsu. On a successful attack with this jutsu, each of the infused jutsu apply their effects as well.
